question: How many procurement processes are in the graph?
gold: PREFIX ppo: <https://ul.edu.lb/kr/ont/ppo#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> SELECT (COUNT(?p) AS ?n) WHERE { ?p a ppo:ProcurementProcess }

question: How many contracts were terminated?
gold: PREFIX ppo: <https://ul.edu.lb/kr/ont/ppo#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> SELECT (COUNT(?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c a ppo:ClosedContract }

question: Which 5 buyers spent the most on contracts in guaranies?
gold: PREFIX ppo: <https://ul.edu.lb/kr/ont/ppo#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> SELECT ?name (SUM(?amt) AS ?total) WHERE { ?p ppo:hasBuyer ?b ; ppo:hasContract ?c . ?c ppo:amount ?amt ; ppo:currency "PYG" . ?b rdfs:label ?name } GROUP BY ?name ORDER BY DESC(?total) LIMIT 5

question: Which 5 suppliers won the most awards?
gold: PREFIX ppo: <https://ul.edu.lb/kr/ont/ppo#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> SELECT ?name (COUNT(?a) AS ?awards) WHERE { ?a ppo:awardedTo ?o . ?o rdfs:label ?name } GROUP BY ?name ORDER BY DESC(?awards) LIMIT 5

question: How many processes were awarded more than their tender estimate?
gold: PREFIX ppo: <https://ul.edu.lb/kr/ont/ppo#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> SELECT (COUNT(?p) AS ?n) WHERE { { SELECT ?p (SUM(?amt) AS ?aw) WHERE { ?p ppo:hasAward/ppo:amount ?amt } GROUP BY ?p } ?p ppo:hasTender/ppo:estimatedAmount ?e . FILTER (?aw > ?e) }

question: How many contracts were signed before their award date?
gold: PREFIX ppo: <https://ul.edu.lb/kr/ont/ppo#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> SELECT (COUNT(?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c ppo:dateSigned ?s ; ppo:basedOnAward ?a . ?a ppo:awardDate ?d . FILTER (?s < ?d) }

question: Which 5 companies bid most often without winning?
gold: PREFIX ppo: <https://ul.edu.lb/kr/ont/ppo#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> SELECT ?name (COUNT(DISTINCT ?t) AS ?lost) WHERE { ?t ppo:hasTenderer ?o . ?o rdfs:label ?name . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?t ppo:resultsInAward/ppo:awardedTo ?o } } GROUP BY ?name ORDER BY DESC(?lost) LIMIT 5

question: How many tenders used direct contracting (Contratación Directa)?
gold: PREFIX ppo: <https://ul.edu.lb/kr/ont/ppo#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> SELECT (COUNT(?t) AS ?n) WHERE { ?t ppo:usesMethod ?m . ?m skos:prefLabel "Contratación Directa" }

question: What is the average number of tenderers per tender?
gold: PREFIX ppo: <https://ul.edu.lb/kr/ont/ppo#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> SELECT (AVG(?n) AS ?avg) WHERE { ?t ppo:numberOfTenderers ?n }

question: Which suppliers won contracts from PETROPAR?
gold: PREFIX ppo: <https://ul.edu.lb/kr/ont/ppo#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> SELECT DISTINCT ?name WHERE { ?p ppo:hasBuyer ?b ; ppo:hasAward ?a . ?b rdfs:label ?bn . FILTER (CONTAINS(UCASE(?bn), "PETROPAR")) ?a ppo:awardedTo ?o . ?o rdfs:label ?name } ORDER BY ?name

question: How many cancelled tenders still have an award?
gold: PREFIX ppo: <https://ul.edu.lb/kr/ont/ppo#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?t) AS ?n) WHERE { ?t a ppo:CancelledTender ; ppo:resultsInAward ?a }

question: Who bribed officials to win contracts?
why: The graph records procurement facts, not wrongdoing; it has no data on bribery.
